hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborist — Insured & Licensed Tree Care
hero_subhead: Dangerous branches threatening your home? We safely remove, prune, and care for trees across Nottingham—often the same day.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery & Care Services in Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency storm damage to routine maintenance, we handle every aspect of tree care with skill and safety.

services.title: Tree Removal
services.desc: Safe felling of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees of any size. We handle access challenges and site clearance, leaving your garden ready to replant.

services.title: Tree Pruning & Shaping
services.desc: Crown thinning, dead wood removal, and crown lifting to improve light and reduce wind resistance. Keeps your tree healthy and your home safer.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Dangerous branches or fallen trees blocking access? We respond quickly to make the area safe, with debris removed same day.

services.title: Hedge Cutting & Trimming
services.desc: Regular hedge maintenance from small residential hedges to larger boundary screens. Keeps your property tidy and within legal sight line limits.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Complete stump removal below ground level. Your garden is left level and ready to use—no regrowth, no trip hazards.

services.title: Tree Health & Diagnostics
services.desc: We identify disease, pest damage, and structural weakness early. Advice on treatment options can save a cherished tree.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I saw too many trees butchered by cowboys.
about_para_1: Special Branch Tree Services was founded in Nottingham 18 years ago with one aim: to bring proper arboricultural knowledge to every job, no matter the size. We're driven by respect for the trees themselves and the safety of your property. Over the years, we've built a reputation for honest advice—sometimes that means saying a tree can be saved, not just recommending removal.
about_para_2: Our team combines formal qualification with genuine passion for the work. We're NPTC-trained and fully insured for all operations, so you're protected from start to finish. Repeat customers trust us because we show up on time, explain what we're doing, and clean up properly—no shortcuts, no surprise bills.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was leaning too close to the house. Rang for a quote and they came out within two days. Did the whole job safely, equipment everywhere but the garden was spotless afterwards. Fair price and no pressure to do extra work. Excellent.
reviews.author: Martin T.

reviews.text: Storm came through and snapped a branch right over our patio. Called Special Branch at 8am, they were here by 2pm same day. Very professional, made the area safe and took all the wood away. Really impressed with how quickly they responded.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: We've used them three times now for different hedges and a dead tree. They always give honest advice—told us not to remove one tree that we thought was done for, and it's thriving now. No nonsense, fair prices, tidy work. Recommend them to everyone.
reviews.author: Robert D.
